fields.heading: Trusted by teams across music and brand marketing
From brief to shortlist in minutes.
fields.subheading: Tell us the campaign. The matching engine does the rest.

items.title: Set the brief
items.body: Market position, target age, gender split, regions and brand tone. Takes about two minutes.

items.title: We score the overlap
items.body: The engine compares your campaign against real artist audience data — not follower counts.

items.title: Get a ranked shortlist
items.body: Every match comes with a score and the signals behind it, so you can defend the pick.

fields.heading: Partnerships backed by data, not hunches.

items.title: Audience compatibility
items.body: A single score for how well a brand's customers and an artist's listeners actually overlap.

items.title: Brand & artist signals
items.body: See the tags driving a match — wellness culture, indie lifestyle, low-sugar beverage, taste-led audience.

items.title: Vibe alignment
items.body: Compare campaign tone against artist tone across energetic, elegant, bold, urban and global.

items.title: Ranked matches
items.body: A ten-deep shortlist with match scores, demographic splits and regional strength on every row.

items.title: Regional reach
items.body: Know which markets a partnership actually lands in before you commit budget.

items.title: Built for both sides
items.body: Brands find artists. Artists, managers and labels find brands. Same engine, both directions.
